definitions.gloss: artistic style; painting style; style of illustration
definitions.explanation: The distinctive visual style characteristic of a particular artist, school, or period. Used for painting, illustration, manga, and other visual art forms.

examples.japanese: この{画家|がか}は{独特|どくとく}の{画風|がふう}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: This painter has a distinctive artistic style.

examples.japanese: {画風|がふう}が{変|か}わったと{言|い}われることがある。
examples.english: People sometimes say that my artistic style has changed.

examples.japanese: あの{漫画家|まんがか}は{連載|れんさい}を{重|かさ}ねるうちに{画風|がふう}が{大|おお}きく{変化|へんか}した。
examples.english: That manga artist's drawing style changed dramatically over the course of serialization.

notes:
Composed of {画|が} (picture, painting) + {風|ふう} (style, manner). The suffix {風|ふう} indicates a characteristic style or way of doing something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画風|がふう}が{変|か}わる (one's artistic style changes)
- {独特|どくとく}の{画風|がふう} (distinctive artistic style)
- {画風|がふう}を{確立|かくりつ}する (establish one's artistic style)
- {写実的|しゃじつてき}な{画風|がふう} (realistic painting style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作風|さくふう} — creative style (broader, applies to writing, music, etc.)
- {画法|がほう} — painting technique (focuses on method rather than style)
- タッチ — touch (loanword, used for the feel or quality of brushwork or line work)
